name: runraid
description: MCP server for Unraid homelab servers — query array health, Docker containers, VMs, and metrics, and drive Docker/VM/array lifecycle operations.

interface.shortDescription: Query and manage Unraid array, Docker, VMs, and system metrics
interface.longDescription: MCP server that bridges Claude to the Unraid GraphQL API. Read actions cover array health and capacity, Docker container state and logs, virtual machines, system info, CPU/memory/temperature metrics, UPS status, log files, plugins, parity history, and remote access. Write actions cover Docker and VM lifecycle, array start/stop, parity checks, and notification management. Reads require the unraid:read scope; writes require unraid:admin.
defaultPrompt: What is my Unraid array status and how much space is used?
List all running Docker containers on my Unraid server.
Show me the current CPU, memory, and temperature metrics for my Unraid system.
